matchupOfTheWeek.title: Pass Offense vs. Pass Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our pass offense grades 77/100 (above average) against MIA's pass defense at 3/100 (among the NFL's worst) — the widest statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Miami's pass defense is historically bad—a 3/100 grade that ranks among the NFL's worst—and our pass offense, graded 77/100, represents the single widest statistical edge on the board this week. That's the kind of mismatch that should make any Patriots fan salivate, especially with our recent form (0.15 EPA/play over the last three games) trending better than Miami's (-0.06). The catch? We're heading to Hard Rock Stadium on the road for an afternoon kickoff, and Miami's rush offense grades at 90/100—elite territory—which means they'll test our run defense (55/100) while we ought to be able to shred their secondary at will. We're favored by a touchdown for good reason, but road games carry their own gravity, and Miami's won three of our last five meetings; if we can avoid shooting ourselves in the foot, this should be our day to put up points.
